sections.title: A family business *since 1978*
body: Carl Bryan began his paving career at 22, working for the state of South Carolina, then spent eight years at W. C. Wall Construction before partnering with Jan H. Bryan to form Aiken Asphalt Paving.
Aiken Asphalt Paving became Pave-Way of Augusta, Aiken Inc. in 1978. Today Tripp Bryan is general manager, running the daily operations with the same commitment to quality on every job.
